name: Veedol Corporation Limited
summary: Veedol Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and marketing of lubricants under the Veedol brand in India. It offers automotive lubricants, including two-wheeler, passenger car motor, commercial vehicle, tractor, off-highway, and gear and transmission oils, as well as greases, EV fluids, and OEM oils.
